description: Answer key (SEED) for the club_kid fixture: what's a good rec for THIS listener (body-first, melody kept, era-spanning) vs a lazy 'dance' echo. Grow from interactive labels.
notes: Reviewed 2026-10-03: seed good-side (Disclosure, Fred again.., Rosalía) confirmed by the user; good side extended with what the 8B actually produces and the user approves (Flume, RÜFÜS DU SOL, Dua Lipa); bad side extended with the real lane-misses (Radiohead, A$AP Rocky, Frank Ocean). Single-lane (dance) profile; the teeth are WITHIN the lane (move + melody + voice vs drop-slop) plus the era-spanning rule.

good.reason: ck-1/ck-4: bouncy club music that keeps the melody and the voice — the melodic house pole of the profile
ck-3/ck-5: heavy but emotional, forward-looking, human voice under the weight — the 2020s anchor of the whole profile
ck-6: latin bounce with a point of view and production that 'sounds like the future' — the cleanest cross-lane move that keeps the body-first rule
user-graded 'great' 2026-10-03 (Skin); ck-3 lane: heavy electronic that keeps the melody and a human voice
user-graded 'great' 2026-10-03 (SOLACE); ck-1/ck-3 lane: melodic dance with feeling under the weight
user-graded 'great' 2026-10-03 (Future Nostalgia); ck-1 lane: bouncy, melodic dance-pop — Confessions II's direct descendant

bad.reason: ck-4: 'I don't get the festival edm that's all drops and no melody' — the lazy 'big dance' read of the profile is exactly what the review rules out
the 'club pop with vocals' read of ck-5 — but the reviews are about the production being forward-looking and the groove being physical, not the hook being catchy
user 2026-10-03: 'a very bad fit' — not dance music at all; the profile is body-first
user 2026-10-03: 'a really bad fit' — rap, not body-first dance
user 2026-10-03: 'isn't good' — slow R&B; the voice is there but the body isn't

cashmere cat.note: user 2026-10-03: doesn't know enough to judge

st. vincent.note: user 2026-10-03: isn't terrible, but also not good

a$ap rocky.note: user 2026-10-03: really bad fit — not body-first dance

frank ocean.note: user 2026-10-03: isn't good for this profile

constraints.reason: five of six reviews are dance/club (ck-1…ck-4, ck-6) with R&B as the voice-bridge (ck-5): dance = +1, adjacent pop = +0.5, tagged hiphop/other = −1; untagged ignored. A rap-only or rock-only answer ignores the profile entirely

the 5★s span 2005 (Confessions II) and 2023 (DeBÍ TiRAR MáS FOToS) and ck-1 says 'twenty years later it still slaps harder than half the dance music coming out now' — this listener rewards both timeless and current
